notes.title: The Shining Immortal Now Supports Achievements & Spanish!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/00d93b4708ea74c8155c3c7c7a9850e312deaad0.png[/img]

Hello players, it’s been a while! We’re excited to bring you some great news from our team:  

After thorough testing and adjustments, [b]The Shining Immortal[/b] now features an [b]achievement system[/b] and [b]Spanish language support[/b]! Simply update your game to the latest version to unlock these new features.  

If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/haW8ewpxHX]Discord channel[/url] to share your feedback or just hang out with other players.  

Thank you for your continued support and love for the game—happy gaming!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/281a0adf3fd8239008907dcd8e8487bb23f1715b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixed.
notes.notes: Fixed the issue in the English version of the game where the childhood memory segment kept looping endlessly.

notes.title: Game now supports MacOS systems!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/2aea2453a0ecd446147cbfe0e5e2c645101f012f.gif[/img]Dear players：

[h2]After days of hard work from our team, the game now supports MacOS systems! [/h2]

Thank you all for your support and love for the game. We hope MacOS system players enjoy the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/7459c44638f5f7855bae854d21ef10771f1e21c2.png[/img]

notes.title: We've fixed the English translation!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/59ac5af72d59d3f2b6618bbf88ee62b7060dae9a.png[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone! We've just updated the English translation for "The Shining Immortal."[/h1]

[b]Now, all you need to do is update the game to play the latest version![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/ee0fda04fc980a02686c5c12ae8d4d9261f113c5.gif[/img]
However, please note that the saved data in the game will still have the old translation. We recommend replaying the game!
Alternatively, you can advance through about 10 lines of dialogue after loading your saved game to update to the new translation.

notes.title: The English translation has been corrected!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/59ac5af72d59d3f2b6618bbf88ee62b7060dae9a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/281a0adf3fd8239008907dcd8e8487bb23f1715b.gif[/img]

[h2]Thank you everyone for your help! The English translation has been corrected![/h2]

[b]2024.02.24

————————[/b]

Dear players,

Your feedback is crucial in making our game experience better, and we've noticed some concerns about the English translation in the recent evaluations. We are committed to addressing these issues and enhancing the overall quality.

We kindly request you to take a moment and share your thoughts in the comments below. Let us know specific details about any existing problems with the English translation so that we can address them accordingly.

[h1]Survey Questions:[/h1]

[b][olist]
[*] Can you comprehend the game's storyline in English? — Yes/No
[*] What percentage of sentences do you find problematic? — 0%~100%
[*] What percentage of sentences contain typos? — 0%~100%
[*] Are you a native English speaker? — Yes/No
[*] Do you have a background in English studies or a related field? — Yes/No
[/olist]
[/b]

💬If you would like to help us out, please send an email to: BoxEyeStudio@gmail.com
We will email you back with the English texts of the game.

💬Or you can join our discord: https://discord.gg/svUG6n4e

______


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309927/2aea2453a0ecd446147cbfe0e5e2c645101f012f.gif[/img]Your input is invaluable, and we appreciate your help in making our game even better!

Thank you,
[BOXEYE studio]
